info.title: Fenergo Nebula Reports Query
info.description:
**Reports Query API**:


Reports Query API provides endpoints in order to retrieve all related models and their versions.


**Reports Query API provides**:
  • Query Definitions retrieval
  • Generated Reports retrieval
  • Schema retrieval
